services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: The HMA invites you to explore these remarkable textiles photographed during a recent Collections project. Travel around the world with the Collections Team through the HMA's textile collection, and learn about the collection care and photography process for these pieces. Created by the Collections Team, we invite you to explore the exhibition with themes including Decorative Traditions from Around the World, Creatures- Real and Imagined, and the Things that Make a Home. Behind the Scenes: Engaging the Americas at the HMA Mellon Grant Project (April 2018-May 2023) The Haffenreffer Museum of Anthropology at Brown University invites you behind the scenes and into the Engaging the Americas
